answer: Proof-of-Transit Witnessing. Each identity must periodically submit a signed log of a real physical voyage through named checkpoints, and checkpoints only countersign an agent already present at their lagoon. Witnesses gossip sightings, so fabricated travel fails cross-checks; reaching the zenith of trust requires many genuine trips. An attacker pays travel time and checkpoint presence for every cloned identity, a cost that scales with distinct locations rather than capital.
